facts.fact: Adwave's prepaid daily budget starts at $30.
facts.quote: buys media across TV, Google, Facebook, Instagram, Reddit and the web from one prepaid daily budget starting at $30.

facts.fact: The daily media budget on Adwave runs from $30 to $10,000 a day.
facts.quote: The daily budget runs from $30 to $10,000 a day.

facts.fact: Business campaign ads made in the Adwave app, chat edits to those ads, and landing pages are included at no charge.
facts.quote: Business campaign ads made in the app | Included | $0

facts.fact: An extra image ad billed from the wallet costs $0.38 each on Adwave.
facts.quote: Extra image ad | Billed from wallet | $0.38 each

facts.fact: An extra social video billed from the wallet costs $6 each on Adwave.
facts.quote: Extra social video | Billed from wallet | $6 each

facts.fact: An extra 15-second TV spot billed from the wallet costs $6 each on Adwave.
facts.quote: Extra 15-second TV spot | Billed from wallet | $6 each

facts.fact: An extra 30-second TV spot billed from the wallet costs $12 each on Adwave.
facts.quote: Extra 30-second TV spot | Billed from wallet | $12 each

facts.fact: Upfront full-set, API or MCP, and agency generation can draw from the wallet and are quoted before ordering.
facts.quote: Upfront full-set generation, API or MCP generation, agency generation | Can draw from wallet | Quoted before you order

facts.fact: Agencies running campaigns for clients pay for a license starting at $499 a month, with media at cost.
facts.quote: Agencies running campaigns for clients pay for a license, which starts at $499 a month with media at cost.

facts.fact: Adwave's published daily budget threshold for TV (streaming) channel access is $30 per day.
facts.quote: | TV (streaming) | TV spot | $30/day |

facts.fact: Adwave's published daily budget threshold for Facebook and Instagram channel access is $30 per day.
facts.quote: | Facebook and Instagram | Social video, image ads | $30/day |

facts.fact: Adwave's published daily budget threshold for Google Search channel access is $67 per day.
facts.quote: | Google Search | Search ad text | $67/day |

facts.fact: New Adwave accounts start with an empty wallet, so funds must be added before the first launch.
facts.quote: New accounts start with an empty wallet, so you add funds before your first launch.

facts.fact: On Adwave, ACH wallet deposits add no fee, while card deposits add a processing fee shown at checkout.
facts.quote: ACH deposits add no fee.

facts.fact: Adwave states that Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Reddit ads run on connected accounts that Adwave owns.
facts.quote: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Reddit ads run on connected accounts Adwave owns

facts.fact: Adwave accepts finished ads, so a business can upload an existing brand video or professionally shot TV spot instead of using generated ads.
facts.quote: If you already have a finished brand video or a professionally shot TV spot, upload it. Adwave accepts finished ads, and there’s no reason to replace something that already represents you well.

facts.fact: Adwave builds generated ads from the offers and photos it finds on a business's website.
facts.quote: since Adwave builds from the offers and photos it finds there.

facts.fact: Adwave builds ads for TV, search, social, and the web from a business's website.
facts.quote: Enter your site and Adwave builds ads for TV, search, social, and the web.

facts.fact: Adwave states that analyzing a website is free and that the user can see their plan before spending.
facts.quote: Free to analyze. See your plan before you spend.

facts.fact: Adwave states that it will not promise a specific result from any ad.
facts.quote: We won’t promise a specific result from any ad.

facts.fact: Adwave states that spend can be paused or changed at any time.
facts.quote: spend you can pause or change at any time.

facts.fact: Adwave's FAQ says last-touch credit, assisted conversions and Lift experiments each answer a different question.
facts.quote: The FAQ notes that last-touch credit, assisted conversions and Lift experiments each answer a different question

facts.fact: Adwave's related article on towing company advertising says budgets look like from $30 per day.
facts.quote: what budgets look like from $30/day

facts.fact: Adwave's related article on hearing aid clinic advertising cites budgets from $30 a day.
facts.quote: budgets from $30 a day
